subject: Build: Support `make test` when PROG_SUFFIX is used (#2885)
reason: The change is build/CI-only: it passes PROG_SUFFIX from `make test` into the Tcl test harness (src/Makefile and tests/support/set_executable_path.tcl) so the harness finds suffixed binary names. No Valkey server, client-tool, or protocol code changes; there is no runtime behaviour for a scenario to exercise.
